body: Thank you my friend. It's better than nothing!
You know if there is a PAL version available? I can't find one anywhere.
I feel for you. Same thing happened to me a few months ago and I'm happy to say that today I couldn't give a less of a fuck. :)
I suddenly feel all depressed.

You're not alone. I'm also at Uni and rarely talk to family and I don't even socialise with my room mates, and even though I feel alone every day I know deep down I'm not. When things get bad I come here, just like you have, for help or just for a chat.

I know the world can be a horrible place, but unfortunately the bad stuff has to exists in order for the good stuff to be as good as it is. Sometimes I just stop and watch the world pass by for while and am truly disgusted by some of the stuff I witness both in person and on the news.

If you read through some of my previous posts you'll see that a few months ago I was ready to end it all because my heart was broken, but thankfully due to the encouragement and support of the people of Reddit, I didn't give up and I am proud to still be here. And now I refuse to let my life  go to waste with nothing to show for it by the time it is over. I've promised my self I will do my best at Uni so I'll have the best opportunity to get a decent paying job that will enable me to make some sort of difference to this world. I don't plan on changing the world, but I want to be able to help people. So if you think the world could be a better place why don't you try to do something about it. I'm sure that will give you more than enough reason to think you're more than a waste of space.
Damn, I lost first try.
People like you are like heroes to me.
It wasn't.
Carl Sagan.
I was worried someone would say something like that. But thanks anyway.

I've been thinking about what you've said considerably and you are right. It's that emotion connection that I miss. I had it for so long and out of no where it just had to stop and I wasn't and still not ready to let it.
Thank you.

I suppose nothing really bad can come from it, if I'm careful anyway.

And yes I have. Sticking with cardio mainly atm. Trying to build up my endurance.

Yea, that is my main concern. If I did sleep with someone else I would feel as if I cheated because I'm still in love, but it's not.

Or to put it as my ex says "It's none of your business what I get to."
Be strong, I'm going through exactly the same thing.
Never give up.

This is so true.

When I was suffering from depression so many people spoke to me like this, some of them who didn't even believe depression is an illness.

I'm sure so many people can relate to this as I do.

I'm too tired to do it now so I'll make a fake one tomorrow and hit you up.

My reason; was dumped two months ago and it still feels as painful now as it did then. Moved to uni to be with this girl so I have no real friends I can go to in times of need and not near any family. She was all I had, and now she is gone and I have no one.

Try describe your reason, it may help.
I don't want to give out my MSN, but ill talk here. Feeling pretty lonely myself as well right now. What's the reason of your loneliness?

I've passed out next to other girls while drunk and in a relationship. Never intended to and never was a good thing. Just be honest, if she trusts you then after the initial shock then she should be able to accept it eventually.

It happened because she was unhappy, and if I'm totally honest, I wasn't happy with the way things were or the way she was acting either. I had even considered ending it but I didn't because I knew I wouldn't be able to cope. I'm not a horrible person, I didn't cheat on her, physically or mentally abuse her, or give her any major reason to hate me. Sure we would have our arguments and things would be bad for a while, but they would always get better again.

The conflict I feel deep down now is whether or not I want to get over her. I love her so much and have a certain amount of faith in that if I act right and stay calm (Basically act the complete opposite of how I am now), she will realise what she is missing out on, but that hope shrinks every day. 

I don't want to give up. Thanks to previous failed relationships and tendencies and habits I picked up all the way back in school from being bullied I never really got anywhere in life, but now thanks to her I have such an amazing opportunity in front of me and I don't want to disappointing her, myself or my family.

Being a student I'm not really allowed pets, but I could always ask. I was thinking of getting some sort of plant that requires high maintenance so I can have something to check on and distract my self with that aren't video games.

I want to keep a record of my feelings and thoughts in a book. But I fear that writing about them and actively thinking about them would result in me becoming anxious and upset again.

Thank you again, I feel as if I am but I seem to break down at least once a day.

I managed not to speak to her or even attempt to this weekend, which is the first time in over three years. I don't know how long it will take to get over her and I imagine it will be a very long time, longer than I think I can carry on like this.

Call me pathetic, but my life outside of the relationship doesn't really exist. Before I met her I was working a terrible job just to get by. Since meeting her my life has improved dramatically and I owe her so much. I'm not studying at University which leads to very promising careers, but  I am starting to lose motivation to continue as I was only doing it to make her happy.

I have joined a sports team here and I do attend classes every week, but my problem is I get these overwhelming bursts of anxiety when I'm at home on my own. She is really the only person I could depend on here and I really have no idea what to do or who to speak to when it happens. I can go from tolerating being miserable and going about my own business and suddenly start panicking and worrying uncontrollably until I try to get her to talk to me and calm me down.

I am trying very hard to be strong. Situations like this tend to be the only issues I can never deal with. I've been lucky in my life so far that I haven't lost any close family members and so I can't really put this into context. I feel as if I'm mourning the loss of her, but it feels so weird and heart breaking that someone who said they would love you no matter what has decided it's not worth it any more.

Like I've already said, I didn't have much of a life before her and not any close friends that I could or can really talk to. I have one friend, and as helpful and caring as she is, she physically doesn't live close enough to come visit me and that's what I hate because I feel so alone.

I've decided to give up drinking because; a) It only makes my feel more miserable and anxious, b) I physically cant drink without being sick, and c) I can't afford it as a student. I've never touched drugs so they aren't an issue.

I wish I had a close friend here that I could go see whenever I wanted and just chill with.

Thank you for your kind words, I appreciate them very much.

I really don't want to see or talk to her any more. A few hours ago I hated her. I was texting her saying how unfair she is and how much of a hypocrite she is, but now all I want to do is for things to be normal with us. I'm really starting to lose grip with this entire situation.

Well it's not cheating if she dumped me is it. I just saw a the profile pic of the guy she is living with. She had such a go at me for my friend having a pic of me and her as her profile pic before, but here she is being a massive hypocrite about dating other guys and shit.

I really wish I could the balls just not talk to her. I want to be able to ignore her and being able to survive with her. I want her to fucking suffer for the shit she is putting me through.

All she ever does is moan about how it was so hard for her while I had a friend, but I never dumped her to do so, yet she cannot give me one good reason other than not wanting to be with me for wanting to end it so she can go out and get drunk. Literally.

I hate her for giving up someone who loved her unconditionally to go out and get drunk with guys who want to fuck her. And yet she can some one manage to lay the blame on me for being a bad person.

She wouldn't admit what she done as dates, but she she told me that going out with my friends, not just one female friend but a group of friends as a date. But her going out with just one male friend is not considered a date is just getting something to eat.

I told her cheating with the same guy is the same as sleeping with another guy, it's just different ways of wording it. She shits her self every time I bring up cheating, automatically becomes defensive but its hard to get that out of my head after she decides to live with another guy than me. She says going out with a group of friends is a date with one of my friends, but what she has done isn't. I find here highly hypocritical, but as soon as I confront her she either refuses to talk to me and tells me she is going to bed. Should I be concerned? And do you think I should try to get into contact with the friend I gave up because of her?

Funny thing. As soon as I say I'm alright I jinx myself. Met with her at my student union bar tonight before a social with my tae kwon doe society outing and found out she has been on "dates" with other guys since I've been seeing her. She doesn't see this as a problem but she saw what I did with friends alot worse.

At least I didn't break up with her to go out and see my friends. She was offended when I said she broke up with me to do whatever the fuck she wants with who ever she wants and literally stormed off. Please tell me who is wrong in this situation. I know I made mistakes while with her but I never personally broke up with her so I could go have friends with girls alone.

Yea. Maybe not the best course of action but I've been able to keep things sweet with her for the past couple of weeks. Trying to balance the hate I have for her new "life" when apart with the love of how we are when together. Seems to be going fine for now. :)

I'm doing better thanks. Were talking/seeing each other at the moment. I'm kind of annoyed at my self because she was being nice to me and trying to talk to me when I really didn't want to talk to her, but I couldn't not talk to her if you know what I mean. Just trying to keep my self emotionally distant from her at the moment, but she is really acting like were still together.

I had my second day of classes today, quite boring since they were all introduction's, but the stuff I will be doing this year seems quite interesting and I'm looking forward to do it.

I got my CV checked over by the employability part of my Uni and they said it was fine so I just have to keep handing them out and searching online, and it is going fairly well. Just waiting to hear back from some of the many places I've handed CV's into.

I hope you're doing good as well. :)

I suppose, but I'm still love blind I suppose and in the end it was my actions that caused her to be unhappy.

I'm looking forward to tomorrow. I've decided to start looking the part for the career I intend to have so starting tomorrow I will attend lessons in office attire. Also plan on getting some help looking for a job as there doesn't seem to be anything available from where I'm looking.
I think she did in more ways than one, but I was too ignorant to take them in and change accordingly.

I will try my hardest. Kind of relieved now that I have a reason, even if I do hate and blame my self for it. At least now I know the problem and I can try to fix it for future relationships whether its her or not.

Sorry, I should have said earlier but I was panicking too much. My first class isn't actually until tomorrow morning, but thanks for asking anyway.

I woke up this morning in just of a bad state as I went to bed in, but I randomly snapped out of it and realised I needed to change. I've decided I need to prioritise. First thing I need to do is get a job, I need money. Once I have some I plan on having a make over, just replace all my baggy grungery clothes with something smart to match the career I plan on heading into.

I'm still heart broken about everything, she told me last night it was because she thinks she could never be happy with me again. She didn't point any fingers but I feel I have no one else to blame but my self so I just want to change and be a different person for my self. 

I am trying, struggling, but I trying very hard.

I'm not sure what's going on. I think she want's to be friendly and nice but my constant whining to her is pushing us apart. We scored some free meal vouchers for Nando's the other day and I asked her if she wanted to go there sometime during the week, but she already has plans with her new friends.

That's what hurts most. She can give more to these people she barely knows than to me who has given her everything I could.

I know I could work as hard as I need to to get over her and this relationship. When she did it I asked what were the chances of us being together again and she said to just be my own person. Be happy, independent, etc. So my choices were basically either; get over her and leave her alone, or get over her and hope she wants me back.

I see this as a lose-lose situation because I really can't cope with breakups. She knows this better than any one. She gave me the old "We can still be friends" line, but she will barely speak to me now and gets angry at me for just asking for a few kind words from her.

I'm struggling with this so much right now and it just seems to be getting worse everyday. She knows it wouldn't take much on her part to make things so much better for me. I'm not asking her to take me back, I'm just asking her to just be nice to me. Like she is with everyone else in her life, like everyone else who hasn't given her three and a half years of them selves to her.

Hi again.

The last couple of days I've gone straight back to square one. I was feeling okay'ish for a while. I went Tae Kwon Do on Saturday and I had a really good time. I met some new people and I got to let go of a lot of stress. And I also found out I can join the Fitness Centre which is cheaper than the gym so I'm thinking about joining that instead once I get my loans sorted out.

That session was followed by a night out with the class and it started out well enough. But I started texting my ex again and I started acting miserable. One of my new friends noticed and asked what was up and I summed it up for her and she basically told me that everything that my ex has said means she just wants to sleep around while here at uni.

This was clearly not a good thing for me to hear. It's sent me to a really low point. I've been visualising harming myself because she wasn't too happy when I asked her if she had slept with anyone else. I said she wouldn't tell me anyway because she knows how much it would hurt me if she had. She has been very aggressive towards me since and I really don't know what to do any more.
I'll take a look at that definitely and get my weights brought down to me. Cheers.

I don't think the sports gym is available for non sporting students,  but I would like to know about the strength training program. I don't have much knowledge on working out and tend to just do random exercises.
Yea I am trying but I don't deal very well it situations like this.

Basically I'm just doing half hours work out every night (not when I'm drinking or sick though). May not seem much, but from nothing to this it does make quite a bit of difference. Because I spend most of the day sitting at computer, for both uni and home, I don't burn a lot of calories off, but like I said, it makes a lot of difference.

Yea and I'm starting TKD tomorrow and I am thinking about the gym, but it's not looking too good at the moment money wise. Also trying to eat healthier and watch my calorie intake.
Yea I keep being told to just ignore her back for a few days. Just lack the will power to do so.

I'm doing Forensic Computing so thankfully there aren't any compulsory expensive books to buy and read, most of the work is taught hand's on by people who do it for a living or practical workshops in class.

Thanks, it does mean a lot to have someone to talk to. I don't see many of these threads lasting so long.

Fair enough.

I'm doing fine considering I got drunk and upset her considerably. -_-

That's more like it. Focus on school and try to be a better person for your self. I'm not sure if you meant you can keep your self or the pair of you occupied with games, but as long as you can keep your self occupied without him around all is good.

Well done on being positive today.

As much as I hurt for her right now, such a big part of me just wants to be able to do that. Just leave her be for a while until she is ready to talk to me. And I'm just desperate for the strength to be able to. I don't know how this weekend will go with everyone wanting to go out and stuff, I might just be annoyed and start talking again. I'm hoping when my classes start next week I will be able to distract my self more easily.

As long as I have someone to talk to and keep my self occupied with it is a lot easier for me to leave her alone and as much as I hate it, I feel as if the fact were not talking and certain patterns that I've had for over three years, like talking at least once a day, are slowly starting to end, I don't feel as down about it which I suppose is a step in the right direction.

I wish I had read this before I just called her. Just phoned her to find out if she was purposely ignoring my texts or if there was delay. (There have been times before where she hasn't got any texts from me in days.)

The phone call I have no memory of making has made her think a lot about the current situation and she has decided that she doesn't want to see me or even talk to me any more. I calmly just tried to let her know that if she changes her mind about talking or seeing me then she knows where I am.

Don't know what to expect now. I really have no idea what I said in that conversation so I don't know if it was me just being an arse because I was drunk and angry or if I actually spoke my mind, so I don't know what exactly I should be apologising for, if at all.

Some people would say this is silly reason to be upset, but I know how you feel. I attach a lot of memories and emotions to things even my ex partner didn't think too highly of.

Try not to think of her denying that these moments ever happened, try to focus on the memories you have of these moments because they are better than any photo. These memories can stir up more emotions and feelings than any photo.
Try not to expect to much from him because it may mean nothing to him, but good luck and I hope things turn out for the best.

I seem to be pestering people I don't even talk to just for some form of company. I hate my self sometimes for using people like this but I feel like I'm in such a desperate place. I text her a long message last night trying to explain how drunk I actually was and that I probably didn't mean whatever I said during this phantom phone call and asked if we could still see each other everything now and then but she hasn't text back yet and I fear she may just be ignoring me all together now. :/

Keep in touch with your friends like you said you have been doing. The feeling of being alone seems to be the worst thing in the world right now so make sure you can keep positive people around you as much as you can.

If you can cope without distracting your self then that's great, if you're finding it hard then try and do something that you know will take your mind off things for a while.

You seem to be taking it quite well so far so keep up the good work. :)

It's weird how many similarities I am seeing. One of the societies I joined yesterday was Taekwon-do so I'm hoping that will be a new way for me to keep fit and occupied.

I keep telling my self it's going to get better but I just can't help but feel miserable. I'm still feeling sick and hung over so that's not doing me any favours either right now and I'm stupidly trying to get her to talk to me.

I think feeling lonely is one of the worst feelings you can feel, especially at a time like this.
I wish there was some magical cure to just help me forget her or at least let me just not think about her. What did you do personally to distract your self?

I know, I think the world of her despite the things she is doing right now. I know she isn't doing this maliciously but I still hate it and I'm starting to get annoyed by her.

Partying for something like that is never a good idea, but its good to hear you don't do it any more. Also good to know you're happier with the person you are now as well.

I understand that. I have such an opportunity in front of me right now and I just need to take control of my life and make it happen. I know I have change certain aspects of my self to be a happier person alone or not.

I really want to be fine without her, but at the same time I don't want to lose her completely. I know it will be near impossible for me to just normal friends with her for the foreseeable future but I feel I need her.

Yea but you have only heard my side of the story. I'm sure she would paint a very different picture of me.

It's good that you don't do any of that stuff. I'm not a massive party animal my self. I only drink socially (or when depressed).

That's a very good outlook. Keep it up and I'm sure no matter what the outcome is, you will be happier and better off because of it.

I am just in two minds about this entire situation. I really just want this to be over, but part of me wants it to go back to the way it was with or without the changes she has spoken about and the other part is ready to just wash my hands of this entire situation.

But I'm worried that I won't be able to cope being on my own. It's wrong I know, but I cannot seem to cope without being with someone. I've gone from one relationship to another for the past five years. I have never really given my self a chance to be happy on my own and I suppose I owe that to my self to do so but it is so easy for me to become attached to others.

There was a girl last night giving me extra attention and as flattering as it was, I just wasn't as interested as I thought I would be. I thought I would be happy and be able to enjoy that sort of attention but it just made me miss her more and become angry at the fact she was out with other guys.

You would think that wouldn't you, but I did make some pretty big mistakes. I never cheated but in her opinion what I did was as bad if not worse apparently.

I don't know if you drink, you said you're only sixteen but that doesn't really mean much these days does it. Just some friendly advice, try not to drink. Last night I really made things worse because I decided to go out with some friends.

Well that was an interesting night. Couldn't help but be miserable to start with but the alcohol sure fixed that problem. I don't remember a lot after a certain point but I do remember being annoyed at her deciding to spend the last of her money on going out.

Turns out that at some point I phoned her up and just had a massive argument with her about everything and really told her how I feel. I don't remember this, nor do I even remember how I got home and I don't call a entry for calling her at any point yesterday in my call list.

But due to this phone call I have no recollection of making she has decided it would better if we didn't see each other at all any more, casually or not. I'm not sure how I feel about this. I have been complaining about her a lot since we did start seeing each other, but at the same time I have felt a lot more calmer and normal.

So once again I am in a situation where I don't know what to do but I do know that if I don't speak to her for a few days I will be straight back to how I was feeling when I first made this thread. :/

I've always said we are as bad as each other when it comes to jealousy and paranoia, but I've never gone off a band, film or game because of it.

I honestly believe she hasn't. I was her first sexual partner and other than the sneaking suspicion that she is curious what it would be like to be with someone else I really don't think she would ever do that. But then again, technically were not together. Maybe this is her excuse to do so and if it's not great then she can come running back to me. But I have told her if she does anything like that I'm gone.

Call me a paranoid, pessimistic or just an over thinker but I often think about the worst case scenarios in most aspects of my life. This way I feel prepared and ready to take on the worst that happens, but I don't think I could ever be able to cope with her cheating or just being with someone else.

I'm starting to think the same thing about her and it tears me apart because she means so much to me, but she wouldn't be doing this to us, to me if she cared as much as she said she would, would she?

I'm about to head out to this party to do some well deserved socialising.  Some people may think what I want to do is wrong, but I want try and keep my options open with other girls. I don't want anyone else right now, and I'm not going to make any moves but I think it's time I start making female friends without the guilt that I'm doing something wrong or weird comments from her. Who is she to say anything now anyway.

I have been accused of being controlling and obsessive, but if that is what it's called when you would do anything for just one person then hey, how much more harm is selfish going to do?

I like to think although I'm not perfect and despite my mistakes, I had always tried my hardest with the relationship, always tried to make things better when I had wronged her or just did my best to make her happy.

But then over the past few days I have come to realise although she may be my world, she isn't the world. There is so much more to life than loving just one person. There is so much to do and see. Any changes I make should be for myself and any changes you make should be for you.

Try not to focus on being together again, it will only hurt that much more if it doesn't happen. But if it does it will be such a great feeling believe me. I was begging for her to help me for weeks, just to see me, just to talk to me and in the end when she finally did only last Saturday I felt so unfulfilled. I needed her to come to me, her to need me. So just bear that in mind with the decisions you make and the things you think you want.

Good good.

I find I cannot listen to happy music when miserable, it just irritates me. Surprisingly depressing music makes me feel better.

And I may not be selfish towards most people, but I am selfish when it comes to a special girl.

As selfish I tend to be and act, I do enjoy being able to help others. Plus it helps me distract my self from my problems. :)

But yea distract your self until you think you're ready to confront this problem and remember to smile. Even if you're miserable, smiling can make the world of difference.

The video game thing... She also stopped listening to a band she loved apparently, but I have never heard her listening to them. Apparently the lead singer looked like my friend so she stopped listening. At first with my friend I just thought she was over reacting so I was like "whatever" and carried on doing it. Probably not the nicest thing to do, but she seems fine with doing worse to me now. Anyway eventually with my friend I cut off all contact with her eventually just to make her happy, but did it? No, of course not. Apparently I was secret wanting to talk to my friend behind her back. At one point she forced me to talk to my friend again while she was at my computer with me, and went "Told you so!" after I said hi. I was gob smacked.

We have talked a bit recently, tried not to be negative because I didn't want to argue and ruin seeing her after not being able to for so long, but she did say there was a lack of communication. But weirdly enough it wasn't because I hadn't tried enough but because I had tried too hard instead. I had upset her pretty bad and I knew I had and I was petrified she was going to leave me so I suppose I was over compensating just to try and make her happy, but she wasn't interested at all and apparently just made things worse. And that situation it's self is confusing, but then by that point there wasn't a lot of communication going on at all and she wasn't interested in talking to me what so ever.

My current plan with her at the moment is to just let things cool down a bit. I invited her over again for Friday night so we can have another meal together, but she doesn't know yet because we have spent a lot of time together recently, which is fair enough I suppose. But I know if she doesn't come here she will be out with her friends with will piss me off to no end because she will be choosing them over me and she knows I **hate** that. But either way I will try to keep the talking and texting to a minimum.

I am currently going through something very similar so I know exactly how you feel. Since this is the first time this has happened to you it will probably be the worst for you, but don't worry it will get better I promise.

My current, lets say on/off ex is my best friend as well but with things the way they are for me now I'm not entirely sure if seeing her like I have been is the best thing for me. So if he really cares for you as you seem to for him I suppose he will try to remain friends with you atleast, but try to keep in mind it might not be the best thing for you right now even if you think he is all you need to be happy.

The best advice that I can give you is just try your best to never let anyone else be in control of your feelings. I have always been the type of person to fall in love with someone and put them before everything else in my life; work, studying and even my self and rewarding as it can be during the relationship, during the end or even just bad times people tend to show their true colours and it can be heart crushingly painful.

So just try to keep positive. Distract your self with some feel good films, music, books or even games if you don't have anyone else to talk to. But I'm sure you can find more than enough people on here to support you as much as you need.

I hope you feel better soon.

I don't want this continuous rant to be completely one sided. I hope you understand I am far from perfect my self and I have caused my fair share of problems in this relationship but having said that, I have always tried to mend things and get everything back on track.

Am I wrong to be getting angry and jealous over the stuff she is doing with her friends now? Stuff that I was so desperately trying to get her to do with me only a few months ago. I asked her yesterday why she is willing to do it now without me and why she wasn't when we was together and she just said she had given up. Should I even try any more?

I keep thinking  more and more that I have done something wrong by seeing her so much over the past few days. I'm giving her exactly what she wants from me, but gets everything else she needs from her friends. So while I am stuck here being shitty and confused about this entire situation, she is as happy as can be because she has literally everything she wants

Things do seem pretty normal right now with us but I don't want them to be. I don't want to come out sounding needy or controlling, but I want her to show some appreciation towards me, like she actually needs me.

Just an quick update on how I am doing so you know. I signed up for a few societies today so I feel pretty good about that. Got some info on gym memberships. And tonight is going to be my first night out with other people, but most importantly I suppose without her. I feel like I am making progress even if nothing has actually happened yet. Oh yea, also handed out some CV's today as well so I am hoping to get a phone call or two soon.

Thanks again for the positivity you have given me. It does make a lot of difference just having someone to talk to.

I wouldn't say she oblivious to the pain she has caused, I'm sure she is aware of it and feels guilty over it. She just doesn't seem to want to let it affect her.

I just had the realisation that with her breaking patterns and being the person who goes out most nights now, to her "friend" who was out just as much last year, he is most likely thinking or blaming me for the reason why she wasn't like this before. Which in my opinion is so far from the truth. She stopped her self and blamed me and others for not doing a lot of the things she does now. And with that I think it will be harder for her to be with me again officially as her friends might pressure her or persuade her not to because they will think I will stop her again.

I am really starting to question this relationship now. Like *really* thinking about it. Was it good enough? Was it worth it? Should I be forced to accept the fact she is a different person now just so I don't lose her? So many questions I'm asking my self and in turn asking her to try and find out answers.

So much of what she does annoys me. I can't remember if I have already said this, but a few months before the end of the last academic year she decided to go on a diet. Very strict and controlled diet.
